# melanie.studio

> Portfolio site for Melanie Patterson, an Indo-Jamaican American artist and designer working across fine art, web development, and design. Based in Providence, RI.

## Pages

- [Work](https://www.melanie.studio/portfolio): Selected projects spanning interactive design, print, and fine art.
- [Info / Contact](https://www.melanie.studio/about-contact): About Melanie Patterson, CV, and contact links.

## Projects

- [Rhode Island School of Design](https://www.melanie.studio/portfolio/RISD): Interactive design, CRM systems, and print work for RISD Admissions.
- [Glow Up App](https://www.melanie.studio/portfolio/glow-up): A skincare tracking and routine-planning app built with React and Supabase.
- [Brightline Maps](https://www.melanie.studio/portfolio/brightline): Mural-scale illustrated maps for Brightline's South Florida train stations.
